methodology.target: Reuse independently verified >=80% distinct-airing Top5 counts; numeric ID tie-break; empty users retained
methodology.stability_hypothesis: recent weight=clip(2*(cos(channel-hour last7,last28)-0.5),0,1); no future labels
methodology.reference: Original v5 rescored with original cached candidates; strict historical refits of its unchanged configuration. Reference on corrected candidates used for fusion.
methodology.selection: Prefer no loss versus original v5 on either disjoint window; otherwise allow <=0.001 absolute MAP loss per window; maximize two-window mean. Main is overlapping diagnostic only.
methodology.optional_weekly_replay: Not attempted: bounded dual-ranker experiment prioritized

decision_summary.deployment: No new model promoted. Every dual/stability candidate exceeded the predeclared 0.001 first-window regression tolerance. Both requested CSV paths conservatively reproduce unchanged Objective v5 recommendations.
decision_summary.retrieval_scope: Positive-only corrected retrieval and new feature construction were used identically in all new historical snapshots and full-history specialist inference. The explicitly selected legacy fallback retains its legacy candidates, as in its historical comparator.
decision_summary.interpretation: Retrieval recall improved in every window, but the stronger specialist rankers did not generalize consistently. The best mixed ensemble's negligible mean gain does not justify its first-window regression. No Kaggle improvement is claimed.
remaining_risks: Main diagnostic overlaps both shorter windows
Only limited historical snapshots support these deeper rankers
Nested 7/28-day stability gate is an unproven confidence hypothesis
